messages:
olivia: Heads up — presubmit canary is failing and deploybot paused the promo. `preflight/integration` job keeps timing out at npm install, blocking the cut :exclamation:
deploybot: Automatic pause applied to promote job #5421. Reason: preflight timeout (npm ci).
jaVier: Link to raw logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/5421/console — you can see repeated TCP stalls around registry fetches.
emma: Seen this before — usually a flaky registry mirror or transient DNS. Affects only node=18,windows axis so far.
chen: Confirmed repro locally with `npm ci --prefer-offline`; it stalls after downloading 3rd package. Adding `--network-timeout 600000` makes the run go through.
liam: Could be registry throttling. Our runners hit public npm mirrors; we should try a retry wrapper first. I'll kick a targeted rerun with `NPM_CONFIG_FETCH_RETRIES=5`.
qa-bot: Test flake rate: 6/8 recent canary runs failed with same error pattern. Suggest pin or rollback to last-good artifact to unblock release.
emma: Pin option: promote previous image `gcr/redwood/service@sha256:0a1b2c3d` = last green. That unblocks release but loses current change window.
olivia: Proposal: pin to last-good artifact for the release window, enqueue targeted rebuild of failing presubmit with increased npm timeout and mirror fallback. If rebuild passes, we can re-promote and append a note in release notes. Thoughts?
javier: +1 to pin. Also add an action item to update CI to set `NPM_CONFIG_FETCH_RETRIES=5` for node-based matrix and fall back to our internal mirror.
emma: I'll update release notes: "Promoted previous image due to presubmit npm fetch flake; rebuild in progress; follow-up will include re-promote if green."
deploybot: Manual promote to sha256:0a1b2c3d completed by @emma at 1743220300. Promo paused flag cleared for the release window.
liam: Launched targeted rerun (job 5427) with `--network-timeout` env and mirror fallback. ETA ~6m.
qa-bot: Notifying product and oncall: @product @oncall — promo used temp pin to avoid shipping delay.
chen: Filed docs ticket to add mirror config to runner images: https://issues.redwood/INF-789
olivia: Thanks all. If targeted rerun passes we can decide to unpin in the next change window. For now we're unblocked for this cut. :white_check_mark:
